---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for Claude Cockpit
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve, or what workflow does it improve? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you have in mind. Include:
- Which existing feature area it belongs to (or whether it is a new one)
- Expected behavior from the user's perspective
- Any configuration options it should expose in `cockpit.config.json`

## Alternatives considered

Are there workarounds or other approaches you've thought about?

## Platform scope

- [ ] Cross-platform (Node — works on Windows, macOS, Linux)
- [ ] Windows-only (PowerShell / Windows Terminal / TTS)
- [ ] macOS / Linux only

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, prior art, or anything else that helps.
